_: This project's bash whitelist. Copied to .claude/whitelist/rules.json by
install.py — edit it there, by hand, and never let an agent widen it.
extends  the profiles this rests on. base is not optional.
vars     values the profiles interpolate; a list becomes an escaped
alternation, a string is inserted as regex SOURCE.
disable  inherited rule ids to drop (see --show-rules for the ids).
allow    what THIS project runs: its verify gate and its reviewed scripts.
cases    every rule you add gets one case that must pass and one that
must NOT — the second is the reason anyone can trust the rule.
Check your work without running anything:

allow.note: already covered by the node profile; kept here as the shape to copy for a project whose gate is spelled differently

Reviewed scripts by EXACT name — never a glob over scripts/. A glob would let an agent write a script and then run it. Each one validates its own arguments, does one job, and is write-protected in settings.json.
